## Problem and change

Describe the issue and the resulting behavior. Link the relevant issue or discussion.

## Validation

- [ ] Ran `npm run check`.
- [ ] Ran `npm run cf:check` if Worker/configuration changed.
- [ ] Reviewed desktop/mobile and real audio if relevant.
- [ ] Included rebuilt output when shared sources changed.
- [ ] Preserved content, references, chapter IDs, and recordings unless the proposed correction is explicitly documented.

For audio, content, or artwork contributions, include the source, attribution,
and redistribution permission. For code, confirm it can be distributed under MIT.
